title: The Projector Switcheroo
intro: Just as the rooftop movie night begins, the projector goes dark and the screen shows a silly cartoon instead of the film. Someone rigged the prank.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: The elevator was broken, so I climbed the fire escape. Totally legal.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I came up with the snack cart. Nobody questioned me at all.

suspects.name: Juno
suspects.line: I wasn't even near the projector. Ask the popcorn machine.

suspects.name: Omar
suspects.line: I was here before anyone. I was just checking the cables.

suspects.name: Maya
suspects.line: I took the stairs, like a normal person. Ask anyone!

clues.text: The ticket stamp time shows the culprit is not early; the earliest arrivals were all checked in well before the prank, so they were not first on the roof.
A clue shows the culprit is not wearing the yellow poncho: a yellow poncho fiber snagged on the rail, and the owner was seen dry and sipping cocoa elsewhere.
A dropped napkin confirms the culprit is not the striped scarf wearer, since that scarf was found folded neatly on a bench the whole evening.
The rooftop door sensor logged a late entry, so the culprit is late, sneaking up after the opening credits had already rolled.
